highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 3.116.0 stabilizes the 3.0 platform refresh with .NET 9 and WebAssembly support.
highlights_body: It adds span-friendly drawing APIs and addresses Blazor hosting and platform graphics issues. Review the 3.0 migration changes before upgrading from 2.x.

breaking.title: Legacy obsolete APIs were removed
breaking.body: Members that were previously marked obsolete are no longer available. Update callers to the replacement APIs before moving from SkiaSharp 2.x.

bullets.detail: Fixes applications hosted below a base path, improves .NET 9 Blazor compatibility, and adds multi-threaded and SIMD WebAssembly support.

bullets.lead: Span-based point and path overloads added
bullets.detail: SKMatrix mapping and SKPath.AddPoly can now consume spans of points without requiring array allocations.

contributor_summaries.jeromelaban: Uno and WebAssembly canvas reliability improvements
contributor_summaries.Youssef1313: Span overloads and Uno rendering fixes

preview_summaries.v3.0.0-preview.1.8: Opened the SkiaSharp 3.0 line with its modernized API and platform baseline.
preview_summaries.v3.0.0-preview.2.1: Expanded drawing APIs and improved WebAssembly, Uno, and XAML view behavior.
preview_summaries.v3.0.0-preview.3.1: Added graphics capabilities and platform support during the 3.0 preview cycle.
preview_summaries.v3.0.0-preview.4.1: Continued compatibility and resource-lifetime refinements for the 3.0 line.
preview_summaries.v3.0.0-preview.5.4: Completed public preview preparation with platform and packaging refinements.
preview_summaries.v3.116.0-preview.6.1: Added .NET 9 Blazor fixes, base-path support, and WebAssembly threading and SIMD capabilities.

harfbuzz_summary: Carries the bundled HarfBuzz update and the associated WebAssembly and interop improvements into the stable 3.116 release.
